notes.title: G String - Major Game Patch - Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hi again,[/b][/h2]

Today, we're setting the previously announced open beta to be live on the default Steam branch. We thank all those who participated for their helpful feedback and insight. Please continue to report any issues you may experience, and we'll do what we're able to address them.

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

[h2]ADDITIONS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new WebM video support library.
[*] Added texture streaming to try reduce VRAM usage (can be disabled using -no_texture_stream).
[*] Added DXSupport config, setting DX levels manually is no longer required.
[*] Added back the "quti" console command.
[*] Added new sub menu to options G String Options. You can open the Sentry Settings from here.
[*] Added Sentry crash logging.
> NOTE: You can go into the settings menu to disable it or run the game with the parameter -sentry_disable.
[*] Added Sentry permission dialog that opens on first time boot.
[*] Added HIM
[/list]
[h2]CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced total game size by around 2 GB (via LZMA BSP/map compression).
[*] Bound pyrokinesis to gamepad "Select" button.
[*] Updated end credits
[*] Increased an internal memory usage limit, which may help with crashes experienced prior.
> NOTE: Memory issues are still present. We cannot fix it because G String is 32 bit!
> This will be fixed in the Ultimate Edition update with a 64 bit port.
[*] Updated murdock_air8 to resolve missing assets.
[*] Updated dragon_girl to resolve missing assets.
[*] Updated money_is_dead4_2 to resolve missing assets.
[*] Updated perp_org3 to resolve missing assets.
> NOTE: This change will break saves in the chapter Perpetual Orgasm!
[*] Updated out of memory error message.
[/list]
[h2]FIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Finally fixed the "White Bug", in which props and textures would turn blindingly white.
[*] Fixed many crashes related to video playback.
[*] Fixed broken audio issues.
[*] Fixed issues where the game would not launch on Linux.
[*] Fixed file mounting issues preventing certain assets from loading at random.
[*] Fixed issue with VGUI not rendering properly.
[*] Fixed VGUI depth so the main menu now properly appears behind VGUI menus.
[*] Fixed controller config not executing when enabling it in the options menu.
[*] Fixed controller weapon selection.
[*] Fixed a few models and textures.
[*] Fixed a crash with the error material being destroyed too early on shutdown.
[*] Fixed a crash where AI squads tried to gather their teammates when they do not exist.
[*] Fixed rare crash where the player tries to check if they are in a ship but it doesn't exist. 
[*] Intro video and game should now run on Linux via proton.
[*] Restored config files for gamepad support.
[*] Removed faulty Cinema library (it was in-fact, not cinema).
[/list]
That's a lot to read through we're aware, so the highlights here are:
[list]
[*] Vastly improved game performance and stability
[*] Controller support on everything but the menu
[*] Functionality on Linux via Proton
[*] Fixed the white prop bug
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, and enjoy the update.

notes.title: G String - Critical Issue Patch - Now in Open Beta!
notes.notes:
[h1][u]Hi everyone,[/u][/h1]

Today we're launching the open beta for a fairly substantial game patch. This patch is focused on the current version of the game, with the intent of making it a far more stable experience. Virtually every concern from launch has been addressed, but we've opened it up to the public so that we may better collect your feedback and hunt down any hard to find bugs.

[b]Please note this is NOT Ultimate Edition. We're hard at work![/b]
[h2][u]Changelog[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Intro video and game should now run on Linux via proton.
[*]Reduced total game size by around 2 GB (via LZMA BSP/map compression).
[*]Fixed issue with VGUI not rendering properly.
[*]Fixed VGUI depth so the main menu now properly appears behind VGUI menus.
[*]Removed faulty Cinema library (it was in-fact, not cinema).
[*]Added new WebM video support library.
[*]Fixed many crashes related to video playback.
[*]Fixed broken audio issues.
[*]Fixed issues where the game would not launch on Linux.
[*]Finally fixed the "White Bug", in which props and textures would turn blindingly white.
[*]Fixed file mounting issues preventing certain assets from loading at random.
[*]Added DXSupport config, setting DX levels manually is no longer required.
[*]Increased an internal memory usage limit, which may help with crashes experienced prior.
[/list]

[h2][u]How to opt into the Open Beta[/u][/h2]
First, locate G String in your Steam library, and right click it. Then, click the Properties button. From there, press Betas, press the dropdown to the right of Beta Participation, and select [b]legacy_patch_openbeta[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36898536/716ba90e1e867efd790914fdaf317f60826402ad.gif[/img]

This beta branch is under active development, and will change frequently. Make sure to back up your saves before switching to the beta branch!

Please report all bugs in our Steam discussions, or on our [url=https://discord.gg/fUuDyx7uYe]Discord[/url] server, with the label OPEN BETA. Please specify platform and hardware in your bug report.

[hr][/hr]

We're still hard at work on Ultimate Edition, but it'll still take a little more time. In the meantime, we hope that you'll try the open beta for the patch. We intend to share much more on Ultimate Edition when we can, but we'll leave you with this preview for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36898536/58861915ab2c5cef45f232a4474619c260971379.jpg[/img]

Thanks for the support since 2020,
Eyaura & LunchHouse Software

Drones with mounted guns only fire now when the player is in their sight.
Added health and battery dispensers to some maps. 
Fixed flashlight bug that occurred during self-view model interaction animations.
Fixed incorrect water scroll direction at the start of space_race.
Fixed buggy prop teleporting between perp_org3 and perp_org4.
Various script/AI bug fixes in human_waste4.
Fixed forcefield damage bug in space_race2.
Fixed window texture error in smog_storm.
Improved navigation in human_waste9
Fixed Terratrooper AI bug in murdock_air_x6.
Improved navigation in murdock_air_x6.
Fixed damage detection bug in murdock_air3.
Fixed bad npc placement in space_race and space_race5.
Fixed bad npc placement in murdock_air_x1.
Fixed bad spawn script in murdock_air8.
Fixed collision detection bugs in dragon_girl2.
Adjusted the glitchy trigger_push brushes in smog_storm3.
Fixed some AI bugs in space_race3 and space_race4.
Fixed various brush errors in sabotage.
Better player guidance and a major detail pass on hazardous_ai7.
Re-textured brush-based turrets.
Added hanging tower.
Added more animated displays.
Fixed ammo crate error in murdock_air_x3.
Fixed water texture error in human_waste9
No more brush based fences in human_waste8.
Opened up playable area in human_waste7.
Fixed texture errors in money_is_dead_3.
General detail and lighting pass on many maps.
Fixed some particles not resuming on reload in human_waste3.
Major detail pass on human_waste6.
Collision bugs fixed in human_waste4.
Various subtitle fixes.
Ship health now also regenerates. 
And more...
[/i]
The next major update (codenamed the C Cup) is planned for winter 2021 and will contain an asset pass and Steam related additions such as achievements and trading cards.

[b]REMAINING KNOWN BUGS/ISSUES[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]CRASH ON LOAD:[/b] 
[b]SOLUTION:[/b] Add "+novid" to the game's launch parameters on Steam.

[*] [b]MISSING TEXTURES/WIREFRAME BUG.[/b]
[b]SOLUTION:[/b] Add "+mat_dxlevel 95" to the game's launch parameters on Steam.

[*] [b]THE WHITE BUG:[/b] All props turn white. 
[b]SOLUTION:[/b] Restart the game. We have reduced the likelihood of this error occurring but it's a very random bug so we can't guarantee that you won't run into it.

[*] [b]WATER/SKY FLICKER:[/b] This can happen when there is water at the beginning of a level. 
[b]SOLUTION:[/b] Resolves by itself after a few seconds.

[*] [b]SOME VGUI ELEMENTS WON'T RENDER CORRECTLY.[/b]
[b]SOLUTION:[/b] Reopen the misbehaving tabs/restart the game. This graphical error is a side effect of the game being ported over from older versions of the Source Engine. Working on it.
[/list]

[i]NOTES: 

[list]
[*] Sometimes level transitions occur after the screen fades to white so the loading icon might be hard to see. Don't worry, the next map is loading, it's not a freeze or crash.

[*] Console will not most likely not render properly after this update. Working on it.

[*] In some cases when the player is close to a brush and in interactive animations view plane clipping issues can occur. Working on it. 
[/list]
Enjoy and have fun. [/i]

notes.title: G-String Lunar New Year Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've just released a patch for G-String which includes the following changes:

•Previously, loading a saved game would put the player at an incorrect angle. This has been fixed.
•FOV cap increased to 120, over the previous limit of 90. Playing with a high FOV may result in minor visual errors at the edge of the screen during cutscenes, which will be resolved for each cutscene in a future patch.
•Engine limits increased, which should resolve a variety of spontaneous late game save corruption issues / crashes.
•Fixed view clipping while using interactive objects, such as valves, levers, and buttons.
•Fixed an issue where the loading screen wouldn't display properly, instead showing a black screen while loading.

notes.title: G-String : A-Cup Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Today we're launching the G-String A-Cup update, which fixes various bugs, improves various issues encountered by players, and adds additional polish to many of the maps. However, when updating it's very important to keep the following in mind:

[h2]This update may break your previous game saves upon load.[/h2]

This is due to some of the levels being changed since the last update. We've added a new beta branch called previous, which will set your game back to the pre-update state, in case you do run into issues. This will be standard with updates moving forward.

The full change log is as follows:
[list]
[*] Fixed many close caption related errors.
[*] Navigating the platforming sections is now easier.
[*] Polished and upscaled many textures, especially on models.
[*] Many new textures added in the Kennedy Spaceport.
[*] Added some sound FX.
[*] Lab_rat - fixed an areaportal glitch.
[*] Fixed bad water fog setting in hazardous_ai6.
[*] Polished human_waste4.
[*] Polished space_race. 
[*] Polished space_race1. (Ceiling turret added) also more holograms, projected textures.
[*] Polished space_race2. 
[*] Polished space_race3. 
[*] Fixed door related issues in human_waste3.
[*] Fixed some collision issues in  money_is_dead2_2.
[*] Fixed heat damage detection issues in hazardous_ai7.
[*] Polished hazardous_ai0. 
[*] Polished human_waste9. 
[*] Fixed prop collision in hazardous_ai3b
[*] Fixed collision detection issues in hazardous_ai4.
[*] Sorted NPC placement in terror_management_x2.
[*] Missing explosion particles fixed in terror_management_x2.
[*] Fixed flickering brushes and missing textures in terror_management_x3.
[*] Added sign to elevator puzzle in hazardous_ai_more.
[*] Polished money_is_dead.
[*] Polished murdock_air5. 
[*] Rain more noticeable now in the Acid Rain Section.
[*] Rooftop navigation improved at the end of Money is Dead.
[*] Fixed areaportal bug in human_waste8 and polished the map.
[*] Fixed texturing and VVIS related errors in hazardous_ai2
[*] Fixed FOV not being handled properly during cutscenes. 
[*] Fixed various sound system issues.
[*] Game sounds now pause properly when paused.
[*] Fixed developer text being shown in world during gameplay in non developer mode.
[/list]
This update is the first of many large updates, with which we will continue to address issues brought to our attention by players and improve upon the game. We hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: G-String Update Patch for 10/21/20
notes.notes:
We've once again rolled out a new update to resolve issues our players were experiencing.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VNqsAbr.png[/img]

Previously, players were facing problems with setting the close caption language used, as it would not update along with their Steam language. To resolve this, we've added a new option under Options->Audio to select your language on the fly, without requiring a Steam or game reboot. 

Players also reported the text "A.I. Disabled" appearing on their screens and not disappearing for the rest of the session. This text has been removed entirely.

Please let us know of any further issues experienced, and we'll continue to make updates to resolve them. Thanks!

notes.title: G-String Update Patch for 10/20/20
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we hope you've been enjoying the game. Tonight, we've rolled out a new patch that addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*]Previously, certain lighting effects would cause performance issues for most players. These effects were broken and have since been removed, resulting in a performance benefit.
[*]When zooming, you were previously able to sometimes see the weapon model render in the top left. This is now resolved.
[*]We were made aware of a translation error in some Russian text pertaining to the wrong usage of the word "drill" in "this is not a drill". This has been fixed.
[*]Previously, a nearly irreproducible bug would occur which would turn all models in the game a shade of white and break certain effects in view. We determined this was due to extra damage effects, and as such they have been removed, resolving the issue.
[*]Note: For aspects of this update to take effect, you may need to reset your config to the default config. This can be done in the options menu.
[/list]
Please continue to let us know of any issues you experience so that we can address them as soon as possible. Thank you again for all the support!

notes.title: G-String Update Patch for 10/16/20
notes.notes:
Previously, a subset of our players were experiencing crashes on level load which would result in the following error:
[code]Engine Error:
Invalid map lighting type loaded!
Contact a dev ASAP![/code]
As of this update, this issue has been resolved.

Certain users were also having problems related to video playback during the intro bootup. This update resolves those issues.

If after this patch, you continue to experience the aforementioned issues or find new ones, please let us know so that we can address them as soon as possible.

Thanks!
